title: mPocket — Wave 2
track: Track 2: Access and Distribution for MUSD/MEZO

slides.title:
Bitcoin-backed money.
Everyday use.
slides.intro: Borrow against BTC. Pay people and merchants in mUSD. Manage Mezo assets from one wallet.
slides.caption: App interface · illustrative account and balances

slides.title: A balance is only the beginning.
slides.intro: Mezo gives Bitcoin holders access to mUSD. Pocket connects that money to a recipient, a checkout and a reason to return.

cards.title: Make access familiar
cards.body: X or email sign-in creates an embedded wallet. The user holds and signs their funds.

cards.title: Give mUSD a destination
cards.body: Merchant invoices and payment-gated offers turn an available balance into a concrete payment journey.

cards.title: Make the outcome clear
cards.body: Review the recipient and amount. Confirm the transfer. Recover uncertainty using its saved hash.

slides.footer: Product thesis: access + useful destinations + confidence. Independent demand remains to be tested.

slides.title: One wallet. Three places to use it.
slides.intro: The Android app brings payments and Mezo money management into a mobile interface.

cards.title: Home
cards.body: Send to a username or wallet. Request payment. Pay an invoice. Borrow against BTC.

cards.title: Swap
cards.body: Exchange mUSD with BTC, mUSDC or mUSDT through verified testnet pools.

cards.title: Wealth
cards.body: Save mUSD, manage BTC locks, add or remove liquidity, and claim pool fees.

slides.footer: Private receipt preferences persist. Automatic receipt email delivery is not configured.

slides.title: Give mUSD a reason to move.
slides.intro: Business profiles, invoice links and QR checkout let merchants receive directly into their own wallets.
slides.caption: Merchant interface · fixture session

cards.title: Greylabs merch
cards.body: Any confirmed positive mUSD payment to @grey_labs unlocks one persistent random 10–30% discount. Coupon issuance and validation enforce eligibility.

cards.title: Pocket mainnet access
cards.body: Send → Verified merchants contains the 100-testnet-mUSD closed-pilot waitlist. Each wallet recovers its own invoice; payment does not activate mainnet access.

slides.footer: Portfolio merchant and builder-operated pilot. Independent customer purchase and fulfillment remain unproved.

slides.title: A checklist built around real activity.
slides.intro: Weekly tasks give users a clear next action from their first visit. Completion comes from confirmed activity and qualifying referrals.
slides.caption: Weekly tasks · fixture completion states
slides.note: Tasks reset weekly. The checklist does not promise a separate weekly token payout.
slides.footer: Starting funds come from the existing testnet faucet. The welcome reward has ended.

slides.title: Borrow. Repay. Recover your collateral.
slides.intro: A verified testnet journey through Mezo Troves, with debt changes checked after interest accrual.

cards.title: Savings principal
cards.body: sMUSD represents 1:1 mUSD principal. Interest accrues separately from the shares.

cards.title: Interest paid, not inferred
cards.body: Two verified payouts: 187.366117347141378 and 0.00228183663115 mUSD. Fresh and recovered claims check the actual token payout.

slides.footer: Specific builder-wallet outcomes on Mezo Testnet. Protocol fees and reserves are included in debt.

slides.title: Manage the rest of your Mezo wallet.
slides.intro: Supported holdings stay visible. Reviews show amounts, fees, minimum output, slippage and deadlines before signing.

cards.title: Swaps + liquidity
cards.body: Verified mUSD pools, liquidity addition/removal and fee claims. One live liquidity addition has receipt evidence.

cards.title: BTC locks
cards.body: Create, top up, extend and withdraw veBTC positions. Testnet maximum: 30 days, rounded weekly. Previous MEZO positions remain manageable.

cards.title: Recover each action
cards.body: Pending actions are scoped by wallet and chain. Reopen and check the saved transaction instead of signing again.

slides.footer: Broader lifecycle coverage uses fork and wallet fixtures; it is separate from live receipt evidence.

slides.title: The wallet signs. Pocket verifies.
slides.intro: Direct payments move on Mezo. Pocket records verified outcomes and keeps uncertain transactions recoverable.

cards.title: Payment integrity
cards.body: Check network, sender, token, recipient, exact amount, calldata, receipt and Transfer event. Block invoice-proof reuse.

cards.title: Account consistency
cards.body: Reads and signing follow the session wallet on Mezo. Claims save a hash or nonce after an uncertain wallet response and recover the actual payout.

slides.footer: Android 0.2.5 validation covers build, lint, certificate, alignment and APK assets. Physical device/account flows remain unverified.

slides.title: Start with merchant value.
slides.intro: Track 2: Access and Distribution for MUSD/MEZO. The model begins with useful payment destinations and reliable checkout.

cards.title: Proposed merchant fees
cards.body: Disclosed fees on successful merchant payments could cover operations and future BTC gas sponsorship.

cards.title: Validate the economics
cards.body: Measure settlement, gas and support costs with merchants before committing to pricing or sponsorship.

cards.title: Expand after demand
cards.body: Merchant reporting and reconciliation can follow evidence of repeat use. Ordinary P2P sends are not the initial fee target.

slides.note: Today, the payer supplies BTC gas. Pocket fee collection, revenue and universal gas sponsorship are not implemented.
slides.footer: Merchant checkout and discount offers are live product mechanisms; independent customer demand is still a pilot question.

slides.title:
Pilot. Measure.
Prepare for Mainnet.
slides.intro: Three planned milestones after the buildathon, starting with independent merchant customers and repeat use.

cards.title: Nov 16–30, 2026
cards.body: Pilot one merchant and two independent customers. Capture fulfillment, feedback, repeat use and Android account acceptance.

cards.title: Dec 1–15, 2026
cards.body: Improve merchant reporting and reconciliation. Measure gas, operations and support costs to validate a disclosed fee.

cards.title: Dec 16, 2026–Jan 15, 2027
cards.body: Prepare a limited Mezo Mainnet pilot. Use verified recovery, protocol integrations and merchant feedback to set launch scope.

slides.footer: Planned milestones · Built by greyw0rks · All financial evidence is testnet. Independent adoption and revenue remain unproved.
